name: Twofold Heir

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The heir makes two Swollen Arm attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Quarrelsome Grip.

Actions.name: Swollen Arm
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 10 ft. 31 (6d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

Actions.name: Quarrelsome Grip
Actions.text: *Strength Saving Throw*: DC 15, one creature within 10 feet. *Failure:* The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 16).

Traits.name: Two Wills, One Hide
Traits.text: At the start of the heir's turn while it has the Grappled or Prone condition, the heir ends the Grappled and Prone conditions on itself as the brothers' competing wills yank the shared hide back to its feet.
Traits.clause: The heir cannot be Grappled or knocked Prone by any creature smaller than it, and if it is Grappled or Prone at the star
Traits.expresses: two brothers sharing one hide-bound body
Traits.expressedQuote: as the brothers' competing wills yank the shared hide back to its feet

lore: Fused seam-to-seam by an old bargain, two quarreling heirs walk the wilds seeking a fight decisive enough to settle which of them is truly the elder.

generation.userConcept: two brothers who share one body and argue about who swings
generation.cite: composition after Fire Giant (CR 9) — the giant ladder continues

monsterDescription: two brothers who share one body and argue about who swings
